messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Command Line Autocorr/ESS
parts: Did we ever make autocorrelation and effective sample size estimators available from the command line or do we still have to go through R?

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Command Line Autocorr/ESS
parts:
Use bin/print with filenames. So something like:

bin/print samples.csv

The effective sample size estimate is there, but no autocorrelation. Let me know what you want to see and I can get that into print or some other place.
On Mon, Mar 11, 2013 at 8:10 PM, Michael Betancourt <betan...@gmail.com> wrote:
Did we ever make autocorrelation and effective sample size estimators available from the command line or do we still have to go through R?

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Command Line Autocorr/ESS
parts:
It would be nice to have an option to dump the full autocorrelation in csv or column format to make plots. Not something we'd want to have on by default. So maybe

var1, var2, var3, ...
ess1, ess2, ess3, ...
autocorr1_lag1, autocorr2_lag1, autocorr3_lag1, ...
..., ..., ..., ...
autocorrn_lag1, autocorrn_lag1, autocorrn_lag1, ...
..., ..., ..., ...

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Command Line Autocorr/ESS

parameter,lag 0,lag 1,...
..., ..., ...,...

At least that'll be valid csv. Thoughts?
